// diagnostic E2718

Jet.GrammarStartRule

This grammar binding names no rule

What

This grammar binding names no rule

Why

The binding's name picks the rule a parse starts from: the rule whose name in PascalCase it is.

Fix

Rename the binding to the PascalCase name of the rule a parse starts from.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarStartRule: Tests/UI/grammar_start_rule.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarStartRule: `Entry` names no rule of its grammar
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_start_rule.jet:5:1
    |
  5 | Entry: Grammar{"""
    | ^^^^^
 Why: The binding's name picks the rule a parse starts from: the rule whose name in PascalCase it is
 Fix: Name the binding for the rule a parse starts from, as `Pair` names `pair`
